protocol.selection: Fixed-policy retries on exposed old cases and new constructed stress views. No blind generalization claim. Select on development subject to old and new per-fact/negative guards; score only a safe improving candidate on the reserved split.
guards: Preserve every delivered primary or required fact and its rank, even for incomplete multi-fact answers.
Negative record IDs and order unchanged; no scope, trust, tag, caller-visibility or token-limit violations.
Keep all existing fixtures and compare both lexical and hybrid outputs.
Do not collapse distinct observations merely because their text or episode resembles another.
Reject unsafe trials, restore baseline code, and continue with the next registered approach. If none passes, publish the measured failures without a production change.
